title: W06c: read surfaces and exported worker tool contracts
description: Expose the read model with the same contract on both surfaces: CLI snapshot --json with --if-revision, snapshot detail with --kind and --id, snapshot thread with --thread plus optional cursor and limit, snapshot history with --task plus optional cursor and limit; MCP get_ledger_snapshot, get_ledger_record_detail, get_ledger_thread_page and get_ledger_task_history. Maintain one allowlisted contract catalog for worker tools and generate or export from it the schemas the plugin consumes, so no handwritten copy of a core schema exists. The catalog identifies the caller-identity fields (agent, actor, from_agent) per operation so an adapter can bind them while preserving explicit recipients, successors, task IDs and evidence-source inputs; generated wrapper schemas omit injected caller and context fields from model-editable inputs.
acceptance: CLI and MCP read results are equivalent for the same ledger and inputs, including pagination and revision fields.
Exported schemas are generated from the catalog, a drift check fails when a generated schema and the catalog disagree, and no handwritten copy of a core schema exists in the plugin.
Every operation taking a caller-identity field is marked in the catalog, and generated worker schemas omit those fields from model-editable inputs.
No surface reimplements readiness, dependency rules or lifecycle truth.
notes: Acceptance groups A03, A10 and A11 surface cases. The catalog is the single source for the worker adapter's tools; the adapter keeps no per-operation copies.
